product_overview: A modular ERP backend platform covering authentication, access control, organization master data, master data lookups, notifications, and file services. It provides JWT-based security, role/permission-driven navigation, hierarchical organization structures, and tokenized workflows for files and notifications.
core_goals: Provide secure authentication, authorization, and user management
Support hierarchical organization master data and scoped data access
Enable admin management of pages, permissions, roles, and menus
Offer reusable master data lookup tables for cross-module consumption
Deliver secure file upload/download/delete flows using time-limited tokens
Support notification sending, scheduling, templates, channel configuration, and inbox/history tracking

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Supports login, token refresh, logout, self-signup, account activation, and password recovery.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid username and password -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data.accessToken and expiresIn -> Use JWT bearer token for protected endpoints -> Receive 200 from authenticated API
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive error ApiResponse with success=false and validation/auth details
POST /api/auth/refresh with a valid refresh-token cookie -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data.accessToken and expiresIn -> Continue calling protected APIs
POST /api/auth/logout with an active session -> Receive 204 No Content -> Reusing the old refresh token on POST /api/auth/refresh returns an error ApiResponse

POST /api/auth/signup with unique username, email, and password -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data showing the pending account -> POST /api/auth/signup/activate with the emailed token -> Receive 200 OK and activated account state
POST /api/auth/forgot-password with a registered email -> Receive 200 generic success -> POST /api/auth/reset-password with invalid or expired token -> Receive error ApiResponse
POST /api/auth/reset-password with a valid reset token and new password -> Receive 200 OK -> POST /api/auth/login with the new password -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data.accessToken
POST /api/auth/signup with a duplicate username or email -> Receive error ApiResponse with conflict details and success=false

features.name: User Management
features.description: Provides CRUD for user accounts, search, and role assignment.
user_flows: POST /api/users with valid username, password, and roleNames -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data user payload -> GET /api/users/{userId}/roles returns assigned role names
GET /api/users with a valid JWT bearer token -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data containing a paginated user list
POST /api/users/search with filters such as username or enabled -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data search results
PUT /api/users/{userId}/roles with a full roleNames replacement -> Receive 200 with updated ApiResponse.data -> GET /api/users/{userId}/roles reflects the new assignment
PUT /api/users/{userId} with optional username, password, enabled, and roleNames -> Receive 200 with updated ApiResponse.data
DELETE /api/users/{userId} when child relations or active sessions exist -> Receive error ApiResponse with success=false and delete-failure details
POST /api/users with duplicate username or missing required fields -> Receive error ApiResponse with validation or conflict details

features.name: Role and Permission-Matrix Management
features.description: Creates and manages roles, activates or deactivates them, and manages page-permission assignments and copying.
user_flows: POST /api/roles with valid roleCode, roleName, description, and active flag -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data role payload -> GET /api/roles/{roleId} returns the created role
POST /api/roles/search with a roleName filter -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data paginated role results
PUT /api/roles/{roleId} with updated roleName or description -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data updated role while roleCode remains immutable
GET /api/roles/{roleId}/pages -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data page-permission matrix
POST /api/roles/{roleId}/pages with pageCode and permissions -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data assignment response -> GET /api/roles/{roleId}/pages shows VIEW added automatically
PUT /api/roles/{roleId}/pages with a full replacement matrix -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data reflecting the replacement
POST /api/roles/{roleId}/copy-from/{sourceRoleId} -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data copy confirmation -> GET /api/roles/{roleId}/pages reflects copied page-scoped permissions
DELETE /api/roles/{roleId} for a role still referenced by users or assignments -> Receive error ApiResponse with success=false and conflict details
PUT /api/roles/{roleId}/activate -> Receive 200 with updated ApiResponse.data -> PUT /api/roles/{roleId}/deactivate -> Receive 200 with updated ApiResponse.data
POST /api/roles with duplicate roleCode or invalid payload -> Receive error ApiResponse with validation or conflict details

features.name: Permission Registry
features.description: Creates and updates granular permission records used by pages and roles.
user_flows: POST /api/permissions with a valid name, pageId, and permissionType -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data permission payload -> Use returned permission in role-page assignment flows
POST /api/permissions/search with module or name filters -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data paginated permission results
PUT /api/permissions/{id} with valid updated values -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data updated permission
POST /api/permissions with an invalid pageId or duplicate permission definition -> Receive error ApiResponse with success=false and validation/conflict details
PUT /api/permissions/{id} for a non-existent permission -> Receive error ApiResponse with success=false and not-found details

features.description: Manages application pages/screens and auto-generates CRUD permissions for each created page.
user_flows: POST /api/pages with valid pageCode, names, route, module, and active=true -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data page payload -> Verify 4 permissions were auto-generated for the page
POST /api/pages/search with filters for pageCode, module, or active status -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data paginated page results
GET /api/pages/active with a valid JWT token -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data active pages for dropdown use
PUT /api/pages/{id} with updated metadata but unchanged pageCode -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data updated page
PUT /api/pages/{id}/deactivate for an in-use page -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data deactivated page

POST /api/pages with missing required fields or duplicate pageCode -> Receive error ApiResponse with validation or conflict details

features.name: Menu

user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data.accessToken -> GET /api/menu/user-menu with JWT bearer token -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data menu tree for the current user

POST /api/auth/login with a low-privilege user -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data.accessToken -> GET /api/menu/user-menu with JWT bearer token -> Receive 200 with a reduced menu tree based on VIEW permission

POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data.accessToken -> GET /api/menu/user-menu/{userId} as an admin -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data menu tree for the specified user
GET /api/menu/user-menu without a JWT bearer token -> Receive error ApiResponse with success=false and authorization details

user_flows: POST /api/v1/files/upload-token with valid ownerId, ownerType, moduleCode, and fileCategoryFk -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data encryptedToken and expiresAt -> POST /upload/{encryptedToken} with multipart file bytes -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data file metadata

POST /api/v1/files/{fileDocumentPk}/access-token with action=download and a valid JWT token -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data encryptedToken and expiresAt -> GET /download/{encryptedToken} -> Receive binary file bytes

POST /api/v1/files/{fileDocumentPk}/access-token with action=delete and a valid JWT token -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data encryptedToken and expiresAt -> DELETE /{encryptedToken} -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data deletion confirmation
GET /api/v1/files/{ownerId} with ownerType, page, and size plus a valid JWT token -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data paginated file summaries
POST /upload/{encryptedToken} with an expired, tampered, or wrong-action token -> Receive error response from token validation filter
GET /download/{encryptedToken} after the token expires -> Receive error response or rejected request instead of file bytes
DELETE /{encryptedToken} with a reused or mismatched token -> Receive error response or rejected request
POST /api/v1/files/upload-token with missing owner or fileCategory data -> Receive error ApiResponse with validation details

global_conventions: CRITICAL - every JSON response, success or error, is wrapped in a common ApiResponse envelope: {"success": boolean, "message": string, "data": <actual payload>, "timestamp": string, "correlationId": string}. The actual payload (e.g. accessToken, or a created/updated entity) is ALWAYS nested under the top-level "data" key, never at the top level. Example real login response: {"success":true,"data":{"accessToken":"...","expiresIn":900},"message":"OK","timestamp":"...","correlationId":"..."}. Generated test code MUST read response.json()["data"]["accessToken"], NOT response.json()["accessToken"]. This applies to every endpoint below, not just login.
